name: Spatial Mapping
description: Allocentric and egocentric coordinate transformations for navigation, reaching, and memory. Implemented via place cells, grid cells, and head-direction cells in hippocampus and entorhinal cortex, plus population codes in motor and parietal areas.
key_references: O'Keefe, J., & Nadel, L. (1978). The Hippocampus as a Cognitive Map. Oxford University Press.
Hafting, T., Fyhn, M., Molden, S., Moser, M. B., & Moser, E. I. (2005). Microstructure of a spatial map in the entorhinal cortex. Nature, 436(7052), 801-806.
empirical_evidence: Place cells fire at specific locations (discovered O'Keefe, 1976 Nobel Prize). Grid cells show hexagonal firing patterns (Hafting et al., 2005). Head-direction cells encode facing direction. These are combined in population codes for navigation and spatial memory. Lesion studies show navigation deficits with hippocampal damage.
